categories.evidence: Changes test/functional/p2p_addr_relay.py to exercise address timestamp clamping logic in net_processing.
categories.rationale: Adds functional test coverage for peer address message timestamp clamping in net_processing. The test exercises existing logic that clamps timestamps far in the future or past to five days ago, killing two mutation test mutants in PeerManagerImpl::ProcessAddrs.
